-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Script: 03_limpieza_victimas_colision.sql
-- Fecha: Agosto 2026
-- Objetivo: Saneamiento comercial para las 29 víctimas del Bug de Colisión de IDs.
-- Acción: Elimina de tajo la "deuda fantasma" inyectada (Año 2026 completo) 
--         para devolver los estados de cuenta a su estado original legítimo.
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

START TRANSACTION;

-- En lugar de un DELETE destructivo (Hard Delete), aplicamos un UPDATE (Soft-Quarantine)
-- que anula la deuda (estado = -1).
-- Esto limpia el estado de cuenta de las víctimas pero preserva los cargos en su contrato original para auditoría,
-- evitando violaciones de Foreign Key con contratos inexistentes (como el contrato 0).
UPDATE ligacargos 
SET estado = -1
WHERE anio = 2026 
  AND numcontrato IN (
      22, 173, 1273, 1114, 341, 1263, 1346, 53, 
      648, 725, 705, 646, 317, 76, 484, 527, 
      1008, 742, 959, 387, 286, 17, 161, 756, 
      1332, 549, 869, 857, 13
  );

-- Validación sugerida antes de comitear:
-- Si ejecutas un SELECT COUNT(*) con los mismos filtros, debe devolver 0.
-- Si hay un error, puedes usar ROLLBACK; en lugar de COMMIT;

COMMIT;

```

</details>

```
#!/bin/bash
# run_all_patches_linux.sh
# Orchestrator for Linux (Host A) to apply SQL patches (Fix 05, 06, 07) to Host C using dynamic credentials from .mcp.json

MCP_JSON="/home/carlos/GitHub/agua_chatledger/.mcp.json"

if [ ! -f "$MCP_JSON" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: No se encontró el archivo SSOT $MCP_JSON"
    exit 1
fi

echo "=========================================="
echo " INICIANDO PIPELINE DE PARCHES (SQL)      "
echo " FIXES 05, 06 Y 07                        "
echo "=========================================="

# Extraer URI desde .mcp.json usando jq
URI=$(jq -r '.mcpServers."bdawahost-c".args[-1]' "$MCP_JSON")

if [ -z "$URI" ] || [ "$URI" == "null" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: No se pudo extraer la URI de conexión para bdawahost-c desde $MCP_JSON"
    exit 1
fi

# Parsear componentes de la URI
DB_USER=$(echo "$URI" | sed -r 's|mysql://([^:]+):.*|\1|')
DB_PASS=$(echo "$URI" | sed -r 's|mysql://[^:]+:([^@]+)@.*|\1|')
DB_HOST=$(echo "$URI" | sed -r 's|.*@([^:]+):.*|\1|')
DB_PORT=$(echo "$URI" | sed -r 's|.*:([0-9]+)/.*|\1|')
DB_NAME=$(echo "$URI" | sed -r 's|.*/([^/]+)$|\1|')

MYSQL_CMD="mysql"
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

echo "Conectando a Host C en $DB_HOST:$DB_PORT (BD: $DB_NAME)..."

run_sql() {
    local sql_file=$1
    echo -e "\n=> Ejecutando $sql_file..."
    if [ ! -f "$sql_file" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: No se encuentra el archivo SQL $sql_file"
        exit 1
    fi

    $MYSQL_CMD -h "$DB_HOST" -P "$DB_PORT" -u "$DB_USER" -p"$DB_PASS" "$DB_NAME" < "$sql_file"
    
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "[OK] Parche aplicado con exito."
    else
        echo "ERROR al aplicar $sql_file"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# --- FIX 05 ---
echo -e "\n[--- FIX ISSUE 05 ---]"
run_sql "fix-issue-05/01_saneamiento_cruces_id.sql"
run_sql "fix-issue-05/03_limpieza_victimas_colision.sql"

# --- FIX 06 ---
echo -e "\n[--- FIX ISSUE 06 ---]"
run_sql "fix-issue-06/01_patch_sp_revertir_sinc_asamblea.sql"
run_sql "fix-issue-06/05_stored_procedures.sql"

# --- FIX 07 ---
echo -e "\n[--- FIX ISSUE 07 ---]"
run_sql "fix-issue-07/01_limpieza_deuda_suspendidos.sql"

echo -e "\n=========================================="
echo " PIPELINE COMPLETADO EXITOSAMENTE         "
echo "=========================================="

```

</details>

# ==============================================
# run_patch_host_c.ps1 - Orchestrator for Windows 10 to apply Fix Issue 05
# ==============================================
# Aplica la depuración de recargos moratorios mutados (colisión de IDs).
# Debe ejecutarse como Administrador.
# ==============================================

# --- Auto-Elevacion a Administrador ---
if (-not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) {
    $uacArgs = '-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "' + $PSCommandPath + '"'
    Start-Process powershell.exe -ArgumentList $uacArgs -Verb RunAs
    exit
}

$ScriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
Set-Location -Path $ScriptDir

# Localizar mysql.exe (Soporte dinamico incluyendo disco H:)
$MYSQL_CMD = 'mysql.exe'
$FallbackPaths = @(
    'H:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe',
    'F:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe',
    'C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe',
    'D:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe'
)
foreach ($path in $FallbackPaths) {
    if (Test-Path $path) {
        $MYSQL_CMD = $path
        break
    }
}

Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host 'PATCH ISSUE 05 - HOST C (WINDOWS)' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host 'REVERSION DE MUTACION DE RECARGOS (COLISION IDS)' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Valores de conexion por defecto para Host C
$DB_HOST = '127.0.0.1'
$DB_PORT = 7002
$DB_USER = 'root'
$DB_PASS = 'comite_2026'
$DB_NAME = 'awa'

Write-Host ('Conectando a Host C en ' + $DB_HOST + ':' + $DB_PORT + ' (BD: ' + $DB_NAME + ')...') -ForegroundColor Gray

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PRE-CHECK: Contar anomalias
# ---------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=> Ejecutando PRE-CHECK de anomalias...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
$QueryAnomalias = "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ligacargos WHERE categoria IN (16,17) AND monto > 100 AND estado = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ligacargos_historico WHERE categoria IN (16,17) AND monto > 100 AND estado = 0) AS Total;"
$PreCheckResult = & "$MYSQL_CMD" -h $DB_HOST -P $DB_PORT -u $DB_USER "-p$DB_PASS" $DB_NAME -s -e $QueryAnomalias
Write-Host ("   Recargos corruptos encontrados (> $100): " + $PreCheckResult) -ForegroundColor Red

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# APLICAR PARCHE
# ---------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=> Aplicando Reversion Poka-Yoke (01_saneamiento_cruces_id.sql)...' -ForegroundColor Yellow

$SqlFile = Join-Path $ScriptDir "01_saneamiento_cruces_id.sql"
if (-not (Test-Path $SqlFile)) {
    Write-Host ("ERROR: No se encuentra el archivo SQL en " + $SqlFile) -ForegroundColor Red
    try { $null = $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown') } catch {}
    exit 1
}

& "$MYSQL_CMD" -h $DB_HOST -P $DB_PORT -u $DB_USER "-p$DB_PASS" $DB_NAME -e "source 01_saneamiento_cruces_id.sql"

if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
    Write-Host '[OK] Parche SQL aplicado con exito.' -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host 'ERROR al aplicar 01_saneamiento_cruces_id.sql' -ForegroundColor Red
    try { $null = $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown') } catch {}
    exit 1
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# POST-CHECK: Validar saneamiento
# ---------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=> Ejecutando POST-CHECK de validacion...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
$PostCheckResult = & "$MYSQL_CMD" -h $DB_HOST -P $DB_PORT -u $DB_USER "-p$DB_PASS" $DB_NAME -s -e $QueryAnomalias
if ($PostCheckResult -eq "0") {
    Write-Host ("   Recargos corruptos restantes: " + $PostCheckResult + " [CERTIFICADO]") -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host ("   ADVERTENCIA: Recargos corruptos restantes: " + $PostCheckResult) -ForegroundColor Red
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# APLICAR LIMPIEZA DE COLISIONES
# ---------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=> Aplicando Limpieza de Victimas Colision (03_limpieza_victimas_colision.sql)...' -ForegroundColor Yellow

$SqlFile2 = Join-Path $ScriptDir "03_limpieza_victimas_colision.sql"
if (-not (Test-Path $SqlFile2)) {
    Write-Host ("ERROR: No se encuentra el archivo SQL en " + $SqlFile2) -ForegroundColor Red
    try { $null = $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown') } catch {}
    exit 1
}

& "$MYSQL_CMD" -h $DB_HOST -P $DB_PORT -u $DB_USER "-p$DB_PASS" $DB_NAME -e "source 03_limpieza_victimas_colision.sql"

if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
    Write-Host '[OK] Limpieza de victimas de colision aplicada con exito.' -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host 'ERROR al aplicar 03_limpieza_victimas_colision.sql' -ForegroundColor Red
    try { $null = $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown') } catch {}
    exit 1
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host '    PROCESO COMPLETADO EXITOSAMENTE' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan

Write-Host 'Presiona cualquier tecla para cerrar esta ventana...' -ForegroundColor Gray
try { $null = $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown') } catch {}

```

# run_patch_host_c_06.ps1 - Orchestrator for Windows 10 to apply Fix Issue 06
# ==============================================
# Inyecta los Guards Inter-Reglas (GAP 1, 2, 3, 4)
# Debe ejecutarse como Administrador.
# ==============================================

# --- Auto-Elevacion a Administrador ---
if (-not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) {
    $uacArgs = '-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "' + $PSCommandPath + '"'
    Start-Process powershell.exe -ArgumentList $uacArgs -Verb RunAs
    exit
}

$ScriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
Set-Location -Path $ScriptDir

# Localizar mysql.exe (Soporte dinamico incluyendo disco H:)
$MYSQL_CMD = 'mysql.exe'
$FallbackPaths = @(
    'H:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe',
    'F:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe',
    'C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe',
    'D:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe'
)
foreach ($path in $FallbackPaths) {
    if (Test-Path $path) {
        $MYSQL_CMD = $path
        break
    }
}


Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host 'PATCH ISSUE 06 - HOST C (WINDOWS)' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host 'INYECCION DE GUARDS INTER-REGLAS (JIT Y SQL)' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Valores de conexion por defecto para Host C
$DB_HOST = '127.0.0.1'
$DB_PORT = 7002
$DB_USER = 'root'
$DB_PASS = 'comite_2026'
$DB_NAME = 'awa'

Write-Host ("Conectando a Host C en $DB_HOST`:$DB_PORT (BD: $DB_NAME)...") -ForegroundColor Gray

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# APLICAR PARCHE SQL (GAP 4)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=> Aplicando Guard SQL en sp_revertir_sinc_asamblea (01_patch_sp_revertir_sinc_asamblea.sql)...' -ForegroundColor Yellow

$SqlFile = Join-Path $ScriptDir "01_patch_sp_revertir_sinc_asamblea.sql"
if (-not (Test-Path $SqlFile)) {
    Write-Host ("ERROR: No se encuentra el archivo SQL en " + $SqlFile) -ForegroundColor Red
    try { $null = $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown') } catch {}
    exit 1
}

& "$MYSQL_CMD" -h $DB_HOST -P $DB_PORT -u $DB_USER "-p$DB_PASS" $DB_NAME -e "source 01_patch_sp_revertir_sinc_asamblea.sql"

if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
    Write-Host '[OK] Parche SQL aplicado con exito.' -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host 'ERROR al aplicar 01_patch_sp_revertir_sinc_asamblea.sql' -ForegroundColor Red
    try { $null = $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown') } catch {}
    exit 1
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# APLICAR STORED PROCEDURES
# ---------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=> Aplicando Actualizacion de Stored Procedures (05_stored_procedures.sql)...' -ForegroundColor Yellow

$SqlFile2 = Join-Path $ScriptDir "05_stored_procedures.sql"
if (-not (Test-Path $SqlFile2)) {
    Write-Host ("ERROR: No se encuentra el archivo SQL en " + $SqlFile2) -ForegroundColor Red
    try { $null = $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown') } catch {}
    exit 1
}

& "$MYSQL_CMD" -h $DB_HOST -P $DB_PORT -u $DB_USER "-p$DB_PASS" $DB_NAME -e "source 05_stored_procedures.sql"

if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
    Write-Host '[OK] Stored Procedures actualizados con exito.' -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host 'ERROR al aplicar 05_stored_procedures.sql' -ForegroundColor Red
    try { $null = $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown') } catch {}
    exit 1
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host '    PROCESO COMPLETADO EXITOSAMENTE' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan

Write-Host 'Presiona cualquier tecla para cerrar esta ventana...' -ForegroundColor Gray
try { $null = $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown') } catch {}

```

# run_patch_host_c.ps1 - Orchestrator for Issue 04 (Integral Recargo Bug Fix) for Windows 10
# Require Admin privileges (auto-elevate)
if (-Not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal] [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole] 'Administrator')) {
  if ([int](Get-CimInstance -Class Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object -ExpandProperty BuildNumber) -ge 6000) {
    $CommandLine = "-File `"" + $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path + "`" " + $MyInvocation.UnboundArguments
    Start-Process -FilePath PowerShell.exe -Verb Runas -ArgumentList $CommandLine
    Exit
  }
}

$DB_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
$DB_PORT = "7002"
$DB_USER = "root"
$DB_PASS = "comite_2026"  # Cambiar a tu contraseña local si es diferente (dejar "" si no tiene contraseña)
$DB_NAME = "awa"

# Construir argumento de contraseña dinámicamente
$MYSQL_ARGS = @("-h", $DB_HOST, "-P", $DB_PORT, "-u", $DB_USER)
if ($DB_PASS) {
    $MYSQL_ARGS += "-p$DB_PASS"
}
$MYSQL_ARGS += $DB_NAME

# Buscar mysql.exe localmente
$MYSQL_CMD = "mysql.exe"
$FallbackPaths = @(
    'H:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe',
    'F:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe',
    'C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe',
    'D:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe'
)
foreach ($path in $FallbackPaths) {
    if (Test-Path $path) {
        $MYSQL_CMD = $path
        break
    }
}

Write-Host "==========================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "    PATCH ISSUE 04 - AGUA V2 HOST C" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "    DEPURACION INTEGRAL DE RECARGOS" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "==========================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

$ScriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
Set-Location -Path $ScriptDir

Write-Host "`n=> Aplicando Parche Integral de Recargos (01_depuracion_integral_recargos.sql)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
$result1 = & $MYSQL_CMD @MYSQL_ARGS -t -e "source 01_depuracion_integral_recargos.sql"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "ERROR al aplicar el parche de Depuracion Integral de Recargos." -ForegroundColor Red
    Pause
    Exit
}
Write-Host "[OK]" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "`n=> Aplicando Remediacion de Desglose Legacy (02_remediacion_desglose_recargos_legacy.sql)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
$result2 = & $MYSQL_CMD @MYSQL_ARGS -t -e "source 02_remediacion_desglose_recargos_legacy.sql"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "ERROR al aplicar la Remediacion de Desglose Legacy." -ForegroundColor Red
    Pause
    Exit
}
Write-Host "[OK]" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "`n==========================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "    PROCESO COMPLETADO EXITOSAMENTE" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "==========================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Pause

```
